ability.name: Armour Cruncher
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

ability.name: Ancient Defender
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Titan of the Land
ability.effect: This unit counts as a terrain piece for the purpose of picking targets for the friendly **Realmshaper Engine**’s ‘Power Unleashed’ ability. Do not inflict any mortal damage on this unit as part of that ability
